0022600150.text: The Kings (0-4, fifth in the Pacific and 15th in the West) are on a four-game losing streak heading into their sixth game of the season, while the Grizzlies (4-0) sit second in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, and third in the West. Sacramento is missing Keegan Murray (ankle), Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery) and Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), all listed as out. The Kings trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 123-112 in Sacramento on October 25, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
